name: Panzhihua

queries.query: Panzhihua cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: Search found an official Panzhihua municipal service-catalog PDF identifying the Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as responsible for real-estate registration-material queries, public geographic-information platform services, public-interest map services, and surveying-results catalogs. No public anonymous parcel feature-service URL or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was found.

registryEvidence: The official Panzhihua municipal service catalog assigns the Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau the services '不动产登记资料查询' (real-estate registration-material query), '地理信息公共服务平台服务', '公益性地图服务', and '测绘成果目录服务'.
